explanation: This component only turns on at D2 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 90 onward, rarely as early as 82), and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition: then it is about 8-10 if the previous one or more trials also went a1 to S1 and were rewarded, about 0-4 right after a rare or unrewarded trial, and about 3 around trial 82. It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, at any D2 that reaches S2 or comes from a rare transition, and at every step before about trial 80.
